h1: Window cleaning in Crystal Springs Condominiums
intro: Crystal Springs Condominiums are attached homes inside the gates of The Hills. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water, and Tyler handles the quote and the visit himself.

sections.h2: What Crystal Springs homes are like
paragraphs: Crystal Springs is a condominium community inside The Hills, so the gate at the entrance is the same guard gate that protects the larger neighborhood. The homes are attached, share walls with neighbors, and are managed by the Crystal Springs condo association. The listing on record shows a 3,100 square foot unit at about $375K, which tells you these are roomy homes at a friendlier price than most of The Hills.

Attached living changes how glass works. Windows tend to be on the front and back, and sometimes a side wall, with balconies and patio doors. Common walls mean fewer windows overall than a detached home of the same size, but those windows are often large. Shared walkways and landscaping are kept up by the association.

sections.h2: What Crystal Springs windows deal with
paragraphs: Because The Hills is built around a golf course, irrigation spray is a regular problem. Mineral water leaves white spots on glass and on patio doors, and when it dries in the heat it can etch. A dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank brings water near 0 TDS, so the glass dries clean with no spots and no soap film. Mature trees nearby add webs and leaves to screens and tracks.

Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April coat everything on the balcony. Screens are $5 each, tracks are $5, and hard water spot removal in Crystal Springs Condominiums is $10 per pane. For a condo with a modest window count, the minimum job of $200 is often what you pay.

Two layers of access apply here. First is the Hills guard gate, so we ask for the address and your guest list instructions by text. Second is the condo association, which may have rules about work hours or parking, so please check with the Crystal Springs condo association. We carry 200 gallons on our 8 ft skid and need no water from you. Because many units share a building, we can often clean several neighbors in one visit, which helps us book within about two weeks. Patios and balconies are cleaned by hand so they do not get soaked.

For the 3,100 sq ft unit on record, exterior windows come to about $310 at $0.10 per sq ft. Exterior time is about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so roughly three hours, and about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft inside. Minimum job is $200.
